source_line: HubSpot portal 4451852 · CRM contacts + Marketing Email Analytics API
intro_html: Built directly from HubSpot's CRM API and marketing-email analytics, contact-level lifecycle stages, nurture-track properties, and per-email send data, as an independent read alongside Tim's own workflow-reporting build. Every section on this page was pulled fresh on Oct 6, 2026. Lifecycle movement is measured from Aug 18, the date the program went live per the Asana launch milestone.

lifecycle.note_html: "Scratch everything else, lifecycle stage movement is the top metric." Contacts currently tagged into a Fall 2026 nurture track whose lifecyclestage advanced (entered MQL, SQL, Opportunity, or Customer) on or after Aug 18, the launch date. Only Inquiry Journeys and Inkwell have usable contact-level tracking right now, see the coverage note below.

coverage.title: Data coverage, worth checking against Tim's read
coverage.html: Every metric above comes from four per-product nurture_track contact properties. Two of them are essentially empty: Great First Eight has zero contacts tagged (out of about 78k) despite 336 emails already delivered per the email-analytics view below, and Agnostic has zero as well, despite 358 delivered. That gap points to the workflow sending mail without writing the nurture-track field back to the contact record, or a different, unmapped property holding that data. World History has no contact-level nurture-track property at all. None of this is guesswork on the email side (that data is real and complete); it's specifically the contact-record tracking that's missing for three of the five programs, which is exactly the kind of thing to compare against whatever Tim's exploration turns up.

portfolio.note_html: Seven weeks after the Aug 18 launch, delivery has grown again since the Sep 29 check (8,815 to 9,478). Inquiry Journeys' Leadership track and Agnostic both cleared real volume on module 5 for the first time this week; almost nothing has sent past that yet. Agnostic's suppression problem has sharply worsened: the program now suppresses more than it delivers, 465 against 358, and module 1 alone suppresses more than double what it sends. That is a new development worth checking before reading anything else into Agnostic's numbers.

tiles.label: Total delivered across the portfolio, up from 8,815 on Sep 29
tiles.cap: IJ 7,033 · Inkwell 1,751 · GF8 336 · Agnostic 358 · World History 0. Inquiry Journeys alone is 74% of all delivery.

tiles.label: Unique open rate portfolio-wide, bots excluded
tiles.cap: 2,443 unique opens on 9,478 delivered. By program: Inkwell 27.4%, IJ 25.9%, GF8 22.9%, Agnostic 18.2%. Click rate is 2.1% and unsubscribe 0.38%, inside the under-1% guardrail.

tiles.label: Nurture emails that have sent at all
tiles.cap: 20 of the 49 registered emails have no send data yet: all 4 World History emails, and module 5 or later everywhere else. The ones showing 1 or 2 sends are test sends, not audience delivery.

tiles.label: Agnostic suppression rate against delivered, the worst in the portfolio
tiles.cap: 465 suppressed against 358 delivered program wide. Module 1 alone suppresses more than double what it delivers, 372 suppressed against 164 delivered. Worth checking that track's suppression lists and frequency caps. The cause is not confirmable through the API.

workflows_note_html: Confirmed by Kelsey as the only workflows currently nurturing contacts this fall; everything else in the portal's nurture history is retired. HubSpot's Automation/Workflow objects aren't exposed through the connected API, so enabled/paused state and branch logic still need a manual check in HubSpot, the performance on each card comes from the flow's marketing emails instead.

programs.label: Inquiry Journeys
programs.note_html: Leadership has sent five modules now, three at full volume (1,111, 1,116 and 1,070 delivered) and two still too thin to read (26 and 20 on modules 4 and 5). Classroom remains at three full-volume modules (1,283, 1,231 and 1,172); modules 4 and 5 are still test sends only. Open rate holds in the high twenties across modules 1 through 3, peaking at 31% on Classroom module 3. This program carries 74% of portfolio delivery and has produced two lifecycle stage moves since launch, still the biggest open question on the program.

programs.label: Inkwell
programs.note_html: Still the strongest engagement in the portfolio on open rate (27.4%, best of any program) and the lowest suppression rate by a wide margin (4.3% of delivered, against 17% portfolio-wide). Leadership module 1 continues to lead on opens at 34.1%, the best single result anywhere. Program-wide unsubscribe sits at 0.57% (10 of 1,751), under the 1% guardrail, though Classroom module 2 alone is just over it at 1.11% (2 of 180), worth a watch rather than a flag at this volume. Inkwell also accounts for 14 of the 16 lifecycle moves since launch.

programs.label: Great First Eight
programs.note_html: Modules 1 through 3 all have real volume (126, 118 and 88 delivered); modules 4 and 5 show 2 sends each, which are tests. Clicks are 2 across the whole program, so no click read is possible yet. Unsubscribe reads 0.89% (3 of 336), under the 1% guardrail but still thin enough that one or two people move the number. GF8 still has no contact-level nurture tracking, so none of it reaches the lifecycle section above.

programs.label: Agnostic
programs.note_html: Suppression is now the dominant story: 465 suppressed against 358 delivered program wide, more suppressed than delivered. Module 1 alone suppresses 372 against just 164 delivered, more than double. Open rate is 18.2% program wide and climbs to 23.3% on the newly-active module 5. Worth checking the suppression lists and frequency caps on this track before reading anything else into the engagement numbers. The cause is not confirmable from the API.

programs.label: World History
programs.note_html: Unchanged across every check since Aug 31. All four World History emails exist and carry the correct nurture property, but none has ever sent. Two possible causes, neither confirmable through the API: the enrollment audience is empty, or the workflow is not switched on. This program also lacks the nurture_track__world_history contact property entirely, re-checked in HubSpot Oct 6, so it has an enrollment list but no active or exited tracking lists and cannot appear in the lifecycle section above.

emails.note_html: Click-to-open rate (clicks ÷ opens, excluding bots) directly from HubSpot's marketing-email analytics, a purer read on content quality than open rate, since it isolates people who opened and then found something worth clicking. Listed: emails with real volume (20+ delivered as of the last pull); everything thinner is too early to rank. CT = Classroom Track (teacher-facing), LT = Leadership Track (admin-facing).
emails.callout_html: Inkwell's Classroom Track emails convert opens to clicks about 3.3x better than its Leadership Track (16.0% CTOR across three CT emails vs. 4.8% across three LT emails). Inquiry Journeys shows a much smaller gap on the same split (8.7% CT vs. 7.5% LT), so the Inkwell pattern still looks specific to that audience, not a general classroom versus leadership effect.

audience.role_note_html: Split by the contact's Role property, for the two programs with usable contact-level data. "Admin/Leadership" groups School Leader, District Leader, and Coach/Specialist; "Other/Unassigned" is everyone without a classified role. Both programs look much the same on this cut: roughly half administrators, about a fifth teachers, and the rest unclassified.
audience.source_note_html: Original source (first-touch attribution) for currently-active nurture contacts, IJ and Inkwell.

movement.html: Contacts tagged active/exited in both Inquiry Journeys and Inkwell nurture this season, the only cross-program movement the data shows. GF8 and Agnostic can't be checked for overlap given the tracking gap above; World History has no property to check against.

open_items.html: Inquiry Journeys carries 74% of delivery and has produced two lifecycle moves. 7,033 emails delivered to 416 active contacts, and two contacts account for all of IJ's MQL, SQL, Opportunity and Customer entries since launch. Inkwell, at about a quarter of IJ's volume, produced 14. This is the biggest open question on the program and it is not an email-performance problem: IJ's open and click rates are healthy.

Agnostic now suppresses more than it delivers. Program wide, 465 suppressed against 358 delivered (130%, against 17% portfolio-wide), and module 1 alone suppresses more than double what it sends (372 suppressed, 164 delivered). This has sharply worsened since the last check and is worth checking that track's suppression lists and frequency caps immediately. The cause cannot be confirmed through the API.

Nothing has sent past module 3 in Inkwell or Great First Eight. Inquiry Journeys has pushed Leadership into module 5, though at just 20 and 26 delivered neither module 4 nor 5 is yet readable; Classroom remains capped at module 3. Agnostic also crossed into module 5 this week (30 delivered). Seven weeks post launch on a spaced cadence, this is expected rather than broken, but it still means most engagement rates on this page describe early modules only. Re-check once later modules are genuinely in flight.

World History has still never sent an email, unchanged since Aug 31: 0 delivered across all 4 emails. Either the enrollment audience is empty or the workflow is not live, and neither is readable via API. Separately, the nurture_track__world_history contact property still does not exist (re-checked Oct 6), so WH has an enrollment list but no active or exited tracking lists. That property sits on Tim's build list and blocks WH from ever appearing in the lifecycle section above.

GF8 and Agnostic still have essentially no contact-level nurture tracking despite actively sending (336 and 358 delivered). Nothing in the lifecycle section can include them. Worth comparing against what Tim's reporting rebuild finds.

Tim's reporting-structure rebuild is still open and is now the binding constraint. It was due Aug 17 and is seven weeks overdue in Asana as of Oct 6. This page is a workaround built from raw API pulls; the Tier 1/2/3 reporting it is standing in for is what the Dec 18 program end and Jan 11 postmortem are supposed to read from.
Confirm enabled/paused state and branch logic for all 5 flows directly in HubSpot. Still not readable via API.

Query note for the next refresh: the nurture_track* properties store the internal value Active, while the display label reads "Active - Inkwell Nurture" and so on per product. Filtering on the label returns zero rows silently. Filter on Active.

footnote_html: Source: HubSpot portal 4451852. CRM contact query API (lifecyclestage v2 stage-entry dates, nurture_track properties) and Marketing Email Analytics API (OVERVIEW, per-email, bots excluded), both pulled Oct 6, 2026, scoped to the 5 confirmed Fall 2026 nurture programs via the nurture property on MARKETING_EMAIL. Lifecycle movement measured from Aug 18, 2026, the launch date recorded on the Asana milestone. Email window Jul 30 to Oct 6, 2026. Active-contact counts are contacts currently tagged Active, so contacts who have exited are not counted. Workflow enabled/paused state is not available via API.
